expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'createForm=' + (t.includes('Create a team') && t.includes('Create team')) + ';myTeams=' + (t.includes('My teams')) + ';team=' + (t.includes('core-team')) + ';ownerBadge=' + (t.includes('OWNER')); })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('core-team')); if (!b) return 'team button not found'; b.click(); return 'selected core-team'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'detail=' + (t.includes('core-team')) + ';adminMember=' + (t.includes('admin@constellation.local')) + ';viewerMember=' + (t.includes('viewer@constellation.local')) + ';addForm=' + (t.toLowerCase().includes('add member by email')) + ';canManage=' + (t.includes('you can manage members')); })()
